title: An eval comment describes a setup that does not exist
what: evals/plugin/setup-fixture.sh:4-5 describes a PATH setup (core's bin/ and a git shim) that bin/ci does not make.
why: The comment tells the next reader how the eval run is built, and it is not so.
failing_case: evals/plugin/setup-fixture.sh:4-5 says bin/ci puts core's bin/ and a git shim (.ci/evalbin) first on PATH. bin/ci:50 puts only plugins/core/bin first, which holds only kit, and no .ci/evalbin or shim exists anywhere in the repository (git grep evalbin finds nothing outside the plans). The handover's other pointer, case.yaml:3, is the description line of every case and none of them was found wrong; if one is, name it here. Should describe what bin/ci really does
